item.title: Linn County Bridge Project Begins December 15th
item.description: The Badger Creek Bridge replacement project will begin this month as part of MoDOT’s Northwest Bridge Bundle. The Missouri Department of Transportation announced the Linn County, Route 11 Badger Creek Bridge, located north of New Boston, is scheduled to close on December 15th.
